description: This file defines the main controller class 'SugarController' for the SuiteCRM application, handling request routing, module and action setup, view processing, and common actions like save, delete, mass update, and more. It serves as the central point for managing the application's workflow and interaction between the user interface and business logic.

classes.name: SugarController
classes.description: Main Controller class for SuiteCRM responsible for managing request processing, module initialization, view rendering, and handling various user actions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the controller with module, target module, and request properties.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Orchestrates the process flow, including handling actions and rendering views.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Determines and executes the appropriate action based on the current request.

methods.name: processView
methods.description: Loads and processes the view based on the current state and properties.

methods.name: loadBean
methods.description: Loads the business object (bean) for the current module and record.

methods.name: allowAction
methods.description: Checks if an action is allowed before executing.

methods.name: getActionFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename or view associated with an action name.

methods.name: blockFileAccess
methods.description: Blocks access based on admin control configuration.

methods.name: handleEntryPoint
methods.description: Handles entry point requests, such as 'download'.

methods.name: callLegacyCode
methods.description: Handles legacy module views for old-style modules.

methods.name: handleActionMaps
methods.description: Handles action remapping based on mapping files.

methods.name: remapAction
methods.description: Remaps an action to another based on configuration.

methods.name: no_action
methods.description: Handles cases where no valid action is specified.

methods.name: no_access
methods.description: Sets view to 'noaccess' when access is denied.

methods.name: showException
methods.description: Displays exception trace details.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during execution.

methods.name: pre_process
methods.description: Hook for pre-processing tasks before main processing.

methods.name: getPreActionMethodName
methods.description: Returns method name for pre-action.

methods.name: getActionMethodName
methods.description: Returns method name for main action.

methods.name: getPostActionMethodName
methods.description: Returns method name for post-action.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs a redirect to the specified URL.

methods.name: action_save
methods.description: Handles saving a bean.

methods.name: action_delete
methods.description: Handles deleting a bean.

methods.name: action_massupdate
methods.description: Handles mass updating records.

methods.name: action_listview
methods.description: Handles list view display.

methods.name: action_default
methods.description: Default view action.

methods.name: action_callmethoddashlet
methods.description: Handles AJAX call for dashlet method.

methods.name: action_configuredashlet
methods.description: Handles dashlet configuration display and save.

methods.name: action_deleteattachment
methods.description: Deletes an attachment associated with a bean.

methods.name: action_sendConfirmOptInEmail
methods.description: Sends confirmation opt-in email to Contacts/Leads.
